mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, student_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, age INT, gender VARCHAR(16), class_name VARCHAR(64), email VARCHAR(128), birthday VARCHAR(32) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday FROM student_record ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
